tasks.title: Map core user journey for adding and completing tasks
tasks.deliverable: One-page outline and simple sketch of the task tracker user journey
tasks.completionCriteria: Written flow lists entry, add-task, view-list, and complete-task steps and identifies the demo path to be built.

tasks.title: Build static task list layout
tasks.deliverable: Static HTML page laying out the task list interface
tasks.completionCriteria: Page renders a task input, task list, and labeled complete and delete controls using reported HTML skills.

tasks.title: Add client-side task interactions without backend
tasks.deliverable: Browser-only interactive prototype for add, complete, and delete actions
tasks.completionCriteria: Prototype allows adding a task, marking it complete, and removing it in the browser without backend code.

tasks.title: Prepare demonstration walkthrough
tasks.deliverable: Short demo script and walkthrough notes for the user journey
tasks.completionCriteria: Script covers start-to-finish user journey and includes notes for showing each interaction during demonstration.

beginner-limited.explanation: Drafts build on reported Basic HTML and first-hackathon context toward goal g-beginner, focusing on a frontend-only task tracker with a clear user journey and no backend work. No reviewed resources were available, so no resource links are attached.

tasks.title: Record demonstration video of working prototype
tasks.deliverable: Video file showing the working prototype operating through its main flow
tasks.completionCriteria: Recording shows the prototype functioning end to end and is stored in a format ready to submit

tasks.title: Stabilize prototype main flow for demonstration
tasks.deliverable: Tested prototype build that completes its main demonstration flow
tasks.completionCriteria: Prototype launches and completes the intended demonstration path without blocking errors in a rehearsal run

mandatory-missing.explanation: Includes the missing mandatory demo video as a must task and a supporting prototype stabilization task aligned to reported React and prototype experience.
